opencodeVersion: V2 documented API; match installed version before copying examples

entries.label: Parent session start
entries.purpose: Prepare a small project policy and restore sourced task state before the first prompt.
entries.capability: Observe creation; initialize through orchestration. Claude can add startup context.
entries.limit: Observing an OpenCode event does not itself rewrite or block the first request.

entries.label: User prompt admitted
entries.purpose: Attach task-specific evidence and explicit acceptance checks.
entries.capability: OpenCode transforms admitted input; Claude adds context alongside the prompt.
entries.limit: Prompt admission is not every model invocation; Claude UserPromptSubmit does not replace the prompt.

entries.label: Before each model call
entries.purpose: Select the outgoing context, tools and request options for the current step.
entries.claude: No identical general per-request hook asserted here
entries.capability: OpenCode agent-loop hook includes tool-driven continuations.
entries.limit: Outgoing changes do not rewrite persisted history. Auxiliary request kinds have separate hooks.

entries.label: Before tool use
entries.purpose: Bound requested files, arguments and output scope before execution.
entries.capability: Inspect or change tool input; Claude decision controls are event-specific.
entries.limit: A tool invocation is not itself another model invocation.

entries.label: After tool use
entries.purpose: Select useful result evidence, attach provenance and record an external artifact.
entries.capability: Inspect successful/failed execution; documented result transformation.
entries.limit: Keep the original result retrievable; preserve the native tool/result contract.

entries.label: Child session start
entries.purpose: Apply a scoped task and evidence packet in an independently tracked child context.
entries.capability: Claude adds child context; OpenCode initialization is an explicit orchestration step.
entries.limit: Fork is different: OpenCode copies history before its fork hook. Do not assume a fresh child inherits nothing or everything.

entries.label: Before compaction
entries.purpose: Include decisions, invariants, unresolved work and artifact references in the summary instructions.
entries.capability: Influence the summary request; Claude stdout supplies compaction instructions.
entries.limit: Compaction may lose details. Validate anchors and required constraints afterward.

entries.label: After compaction
entries.purpose: Record the checkpoint, verify surviving constraints, and schedule restoration before the next request.
entries.capability: Observe the completed summary; next request is a separate restoration boundary.
entries.limit: PostCompact is observational; it cannot edit the completed compaction result.
